title: bb AI response
description: The strict response shape the LLM must produce for every bb invocation. Validated in the C# core before any execution.

command.description: A single PowerShell statement or pipeline runnable in PowerShell 5.1 or later.

explanation.description: One-sentence human-readable rationale shown above the action bar.

risk.description: low = read-only/harmless; medium = mutates user state non-trivially; high = deletes data, alters system, stops services, or runs downloaded code.

requires_admin.description: True if the command needs an elevated PowerShell session.
